components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-commitment actions such as login, submit analysis, and create data source.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #1767d9; color: #fff; padding: 11px 16px; font: 700 14px system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(23,103,217,.2); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #145abd; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7da9ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Evidence Scope
components.description: Persistent pre-analysis scope of data source, snapshot, and document selection.
components.html: 本次分析范围运行契约快照 #18当前任务将使用此版本限制可查询边界。
components.css: .ds-scope { display: grid; gap: 6px; padding: 14px 0; border-top: 1px solid #d1e0f3; color: #507093; font: 13px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-scope strong { color: #254c7c; } .ds-scope small { line-height: 1.55; }

narrative.overview: A bright, operational interface for business users who must see analysis boundaries before trusting conclusions. The system makes source, snapshot, document scope, task state, and structured report sections legible before and after each action.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only general action accent; semantic status colors only communicate status.

rules.name: The Proof Surface Rule
rules.body: A report or configuration boundary may be elevated, but routine rows remain flat.

dos: Do keep evidence scope visible beside the analysis task.
Do use Chinese errors that say what failed and what the user can do next.
donts: Don't use DeepSeek branding or copied text.
Don't display database passwords or authentication secrets.
